overridesRationale.@istanbuljs/load-nyc-config.js-yaml: #2538 — js-yaml (high), advisory range 3.0.0 - 3.15.0 || 4.0.0 - 4.3.0. Two copies were in the tree and BOTH sat at the exact top of their range: the direct devDependency at 4.3.0 and a transitive at 3.15.0 reached through jest > babel-plugin-istanbul > @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config. Dev-only on both paths; runtimeNpmDependencies (ajv, ajv-formats, yaml) is unaffected — the runtime YAML parser is `yaml`, a different package. The direct copy is fixed by raising the devDependency to ^4.3.1, no override needed. The transitive needs this path-scoped entry because load-nyc-config declares `js-yaml: ^3.13.1`: a FLAT `js-yaml: ^4.3.1` override would drag it onto 4.x, outside its own declared range. js-yaml 4 does still export safeLoad, so that flat form might work, but it is a compatibility bet against a consumer we do not control and buys nothing — 3.15.1 is patched and outside the advisory range, so each major stays on its own. Scoped, not flat, for that reason. Both fixes cleared the .npmrc min-release-age=7 cooldown on 2026-08-07 (4.3.1 and 3.15.1 both published 2026-07-31). NOTE: audit-cooldown-check.js reported this advisory as having 'no candidate fix', which was misleading — fixes existed and had cleared cooldown, but npm reports fixAvailable as a bare boolean here without naming a version, and the checker can only act on fixes whose version it can resolve. DO NOT drop this entry on a dependency bump without re-running `npm audit --audit-level=high`.
overridesRationale.fast-uri: #2551 — GHSA-7p8r-x3mc-p8w7 (high): host confusion via backslash authority introducer, advisory range 3.0.0 - 3.1.4. Unlike brace-expansion below, this one SHIPS: fast-uri is reached through ajv, a declared runtimeNpmDependency, so `npm ci --omit=dev` in deploy-dist.yml bundles it into every framework root. ajv declares `fast-uri: ^3.0.1`, so the fix has to stay on 3.x — an override onto 4.x (also outside the advisory range, and old enough to clear the cooldown) would force ajv past its own declared range, which is a compatibility gamble taken to avoid a two-day wait. The cooldown interaction is the OPPOSITE of brace-expansion's: there, an older safe floor existed and was chosen to avoid ETARGET; here there is no safe version outside the cooldown at all, because the newest release at least 7 days old is 3.1.4 (2026-07-19) — the vulnerable one — and 3.1.5 landed 2026-07-31. The lockfile was therefore re-resolved using the escape hatch .npmrc documents for exactly this case (`--min-release-age 0`). Consequence, and it is bounded: until 2026-08-07 a plain `npm install` cannot resolve ^3.1.5 and will fail with ETARGET; `npm ci` resolves nothing, so CI and deploy-dist.yml are unaffected throughout, and after that date the window closes permanently. DO NOT drop this entry on a dependency bump without re-running `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` — ajv will happily resolve back to 3.1.4.
overridesRationale.brace-expansion: #2510 — GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (high): DoS via unbounded expansion. The advisory range is a flat <=5.0.7, so NO patched 1.x or 2.x exists and a path-scoped pin is impossible; 5.0.8+ is the only clear line, which forces a flat override. Reached solely through dev dependencies (eslint>minimatch; jest>glob>minimatch; jest>babel-plugin-istanbul>test-exclude>minimatch) — no runtime dependency is involved and runtimeNpmDependencies (ajv, ajv-formats, yaml) is unaffected. npm's own suggested fix is jest@25, an 11-major downgrade, which is why this is pinned by hand instead. brace-expansion@5 is ESM-first but ships a CommonJS export condition, so minimatch's require() still resolves; engines are 'node 20 || >=22' and CI runs Node 20. Floor is 5.0.9 (#2538): the advisory range widened to <=5.0.8, so the previous 5.0.8 floor became vulnerable in place. 5.0.9 landed 2026-07-30 and cleared the .npmrc min-release-age=7 cooldown (#2481) on 2026-08-06, which is why the raise happened when it did rather than at disclosure — before that date a ^5.0.9 pin failed install with ETARGET. DO NOT drop this entry on a dependency bump without re-running `npm audit --audit-level=high` — removing it silently restores the CI gate failure that blocked every branch.
